items.name: Tách đồ từ chủ thể chính
items.prompt:
Analyze the attached image in extreme detail and extract ALL visible clothing items and accessories worn or present in the image.

For each detected item:
- Isolate it completely from the original subject and background.
- Recreate it as a standalone product image.
- Preserve exact color, fabric texture, stitching, seams, folds, logos (if any), material thickness, proportions, and structural details.
- Maintain accurate scale and garment construction.
- Do not redesign or reinterpret the item.

Each clothing item and accessory must be:
- Fully visible
- Properly shaped as it would appear naturally laid flat or positioned cleanly
- Free of distortion
- Photorealistic
- High resolution
- Studio-quality product photography

BACKGROUND:
Pure solid white background (#FFFFFF).
No shadows unless soft natural grounding shadow directly beneath the item.
No reflections.
No gradients.
No environmental elements.

LIGHTING:
Soft studio lighting.
Even exposure.
No dramatic shadows.
Accurate color reproduction.
True-to-life material rendering.

STRICT RULES:
- Do NOT include the model or body parts.
- Do NOT merge multiple items into one object.
- Separate each item individually.
- Maintain 99% visual accuracy compared to the original image.
- Do NOT stylize.
- No CGI look.
- No artistic reinterpretation.
- No texture smoothing.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
blurry, distorted shape, warped fabric, incorrect color, missing details, artificial shine, over-smoothing, CGI, illustration, cartoon, rendering artifacts, merged objects, incomplete garment, cut-off edges.

items.name: Ultra-photorealistic 8k portrait of a yo
items.prompt: Ultra-photorealistic 8k portrait of a young East Asian woman with a flawless "glass skin" complexion and a natural dewy glow, featuring highly visible skin texture and fine pores. She has a soft oval face shape with youthful, natural cheek fullness and a delicate jawline. Her eyes are distinct dark brown almond-shaped with a warm, calm expression, featuring prominent symmetric aegyosal (natural puffy under-eye bags) and fine, realistic lower lashes. Her nose is slender with a well-defined bridge and a softly rounded tip. Her lips are naturally rosy, hydrated, and slightly plump with a soft, clear-gloss finish and a subtle cupid’s bow. Her jet-black hair is styled in a neat high top-knot bun with delicate, wispy strands naturally framing her face. Captured as a high-resolution close-up with soft, natural ambient lighting, extreme detail on eyes and lips, 24mm lens, raw photo style, cinematic realism, no-blur, hyper-detailed.

items.name: Fashion Pose Tips
items.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic full-body studio fashion photograph of the same woman from the reference image, preserving 100% exact facial identity, bone structure, age, ethnicity, skin tone, hair color, hairstyle, and overall likeness. No alterations.
Body pose must match the provided pose reference exactly — identical posture, limb positioning, balance, and weight distribution. No interpretation or modification.
She wears the exact same outfit from the reference image. Natural fit, realistic fabric drape, no redesign.
Expression: calm, confident, subtle natural smile, eyes open and forward. No retouching, no skin smoothing. Preserve natural skin texture and pores.
Background: clean professional studio, soft neutral beige, evenly lit, minimal gradient, no distractions.
Style: high-end editorial fashion photography, ultra-realistic, true-to-life colors, no CGI or stylization.
Lighting: soft diffused studio light, frontal key slightly above eye level, gentle fill, natural contrast, subtle shadow definition.
Camera: full-body straight-on, 85mm lens feel, f/5.6–f/8 depth, entire body sharp, focus priority on face, ultra-high resolution.
Negative prompt: identity change, face alteration, beautification, skin smoothing, CGI/plastic look, anatomy distortion, wrong proportions, extra/missing limbs or fingers, deformed hands, closed eyes, exaggerated smile, artificial posing, clothing redesign, unrealistic fabric, harsh lighting, dramatic grading, blur, low resolution, noise, artifacts, text, watermark, logo."

items.name: Lột đồ ver 2

items.name: Prompt cô dâu xuyên không
items.prompt:
[Phần 1: Technical & Aesthetic]
Montage, single continuous long-take, no cuts, handheld shake, cinematic lighting, photorealistic, ARRI Alexa 35, 35mm film format, professional color grading, depth of field, 4k resolution, motion blur, immersive visual effects.
[Phần 2: General Summary & Vibe]
A magical fourth-wall breaking sequence. The vibe transitions from a shy, traditional romantic atmosphere to a surreal, seductive, and immersive experience as the boundary between the digital screen and reality dissolves.
[Phần 3: Visual Consistency]
Character: A beautiful young woman with black hair and bangs, wearing a highly detailed traditional red Chinese bridal garment with gold phoenix embroidery.
Headpiece: Elaborate golden phoenix crown with dangling tassels.
Object: A translucent circular silk fan.
Environment: Initially a blurry modern room (foreground) and a warm-toned ancient chamber with red curtains and candles (inside the screen).
[Phần 4: Shot-by-Shot]
Shot 1 (0-3s): [Medium Shot - Handheld]. The girl is inside the monitor, looking shyly at the camera. She slowly raises her silk fan to partially cover her face, eyes shimmering with bashfulness. The camera has a slight organic handheld tremor.
Shot 2 (3-7s): [Close-up - Interaction]. She reaches her hand out toward the physical world. A male hand enters the foreground. As their hands touch, a magical liquid ripple effect spreads across the monitor's surface. He gently pulls her, and her upper body physically emerges through the "liquid" screen.
Shot 3 (7-10s): [Transition - Dolly In]. She gives a playful, seductive wink to the viewer. She then grabs the viewer's/camera's hand and pulls them into her world. The camera performs a smooth Dolly-in, passing through the rippling screen surface. The external room disappears completely.
Shot 4 (10-15s): [Top-down Close-up Shot]. The camera completes the transition into a vertical overhead angle. The girl is now lying back on a traditional bed, her hair spreading out, looking directly into the lens with a seductive and captivating gaze. Faded red curtains and soft candlelight flicker in the background.

items.name: Prompt thiên thần hạ phàm
items.prompt:
The 15-Second Digital Breakthrough
[Part 1: Technical & Aesthetic]
Single continuous 15-second long-take, no cuts, first-person POV, subtle handheld camera movement, highly realistic physical continuity, photorealistic, cinematic lighting, real desktop environment mixed with dark fantasy screen-break VFX, 4k, shallow depth of field, natural motion blur, realistic hand interaction, liquid screen membrane effect, realistic mirror-like glass shatter physics, smooth body motion, clean object permanence, vertical 9:16.
[Part 2: General Summary & Vibe]
A dark fantasy fourth-wall-breaking sequence at a real creator desk. A real man reaches his hand toward a mysterious white-haired digital woman inside the monitor. She notices him, softly reaches her hand out, and tightly holds his hand through a liquid-like screen surface. The touch creates a circular water ripple on the monitor. Her blindfold dissolves, revealing glowing eyes that shine through with intense light. The man suddenly grabs and yanks her hard, pulling her violently through the monitor. The screen shatters like a broken mirror, sending fragments outward. Half-emerged into the real world, she is extremely close to the camera, with a striking upper-body silhouette, flowing hair, glowing eyes, and a vulnerable expression mixing innocence, shyness, and fear. Everything feels smooth, immersive, physical, and real.
[Part 3: Visual Consistency]
Character: a pale fantasy woman with long white-silver hair, slim elegant body, striking upper-body silhouette, soft lips, delicate facial features, dark thorn-like crown, dark blindfold covering the eyes at first, dark organic fantasy outfit wrapping around the neck, shoulders, and torso, subtle black wing-like shadow forms behind her.
Eyes: before the blindfold disappears, glowing blue-white light is already visible faintly from behind the cloth; when the blindfold dissolves, her eyes burst through with matching focused light rays and supernatural glow.
Expression progression: calm and distant at first, then curious and shy, then startled and frightened during the pull, finally very close to the camera with a vulnerable, embarrassed, overwhelmed look.
Foreground Environment: real modern desk setup matching the reference image, large widescreen monitor with a screen light bar above, mechanical keyboard in cream/orange/black tones, tablet screen below the monitor, desk accessories, warm dim room light, subtle red-orange ambient reflections, the man’s real hand and forearm entering from the lower right.
Digital Environment: bright ethereal cloudy fantasy background inside the monitor, soft white and pale blue light, dreamy depth, faint storm-like energy.
Effects: circular water-ripple at finger contact, smooth membrane distortion on the screen surface, dissolving blindfold particles, glowing eye beams, violent mirror-like glass fracture from the monitor surface and edges during the pull, drifting glass fragments, glowing particles, unstable portal energy inside the broken monitor.
[Part 4: Shot-by-Shot Timeline]
0.0-2.5s [The Real Desk Establishing]
First-person POV facing the real desk setup. The large monitor dominates the frame, with the screen light bar visible above it, the tablet below, and the cream/orange/black mechanical keyboard in the foreground. On the monitor is the white-haired fantasy woman in close-up, head slightly lowered, almost motionless. The camera has a subtle natural handheld sway. Everything feels grounded and real.
2.5-4.8s [The Reach]
The real man’s hand slowly enters from the lower right and reaches toward the woman on the screen. She notices the movement and gently lifts her own hand toward him from inside the monitor. Her motion is smooth, graceful, and natural. Their hands align precisely at the same point on the display, creating anticipation and realism.
4.8-6.4s [The Touch]
Their hands meet through the screen. The monitor behaves like a thin liquid membrane. A perfectly circular water ripple spreads outward from the contact point across the display surface. Her fingers close around his hand in a firm, believable grip. Behind the blindfold, bright blue-white eyes are already glowing through the fabric. The blindfold begins to dissolve into dark particles, and as it disappears, her eyes flare open with matching radiant beams of light.
6.4-8.9s [The Pull and Shatter]
The man suddenly grips her forearm tightly and yanks her forward with force. This is the key action. Her arm tears through the monitor first, then her shoulder and upper torso are dragged through the screen. At the exact moment of the hard pull, the monitor explodes like shattered mirror glass. Fractures spread from the contact point and across the edges, then sharp reflective shards burst outward in all directions toward the desk and camera. The glass feels physical, heavy, and dangerous, with realistic reflections from the warm desk lighting and screen light bar.
8.9-11.6s [Halfway Through the Screen]
She is now pulled more than halfway out of the monitor, extremely close to the camera. Her white hair spills forward, her upper-body silhouette is clearly defined, her outfit clings around the neck, shoulders, and chest area in a striking but tasteful cinematic way. Her face is near the lens, and her expression is a mix of innocence, embarrassment, shock, and fear from being pulled into the real world. Her glowing eyes remain intense. Broken glass continues falling, bouncing, and sliding across the keyboard and desk below. The broken monitor behind her flickers like an unstable portal.
11.6-13.6s [Dragged Into Reality]
The man keeps pulling, and her body comes farther out over the desk. One hand instinctively braces against the real surface while the rest of her follows through the shattered opening. Tiny glass pieces keep dropping from the broken monitor edges. The camera reacts with a slight backward stumble, increasing immersion. Her face remains very close, breathing visible, expression vulnerable and overwhelmed, while her eyes keep shining unnaturally bright.
13.6-15.0s [Final Hook]
Now almost fully in the real world, she pauses and looks directly into the lens from very close range. Small glass particles drift around her face. The shattered monitor behind her pulses with dim portal light. She slowly reaches one hand toward the camera as if trying to cross one final boundary. End at the exact moment her fingertips are about to touch the lens.
[Optional Negative Guidance]
no cuts, no extra fingers, no broken anatomy, no duplicated hands, no rubbery limbs, no fake cartoon motion, no random object changes, no weak shatter effect, no floating glass without cause, no stiff hand interaction, no jittery character motion, no inconsistent desk layout

items.name: Di chuyển 1
items.prompt: Giữ khuôn mặt gốc, không thay đổi. Cô gái mỉm cười rạng rỡ, đưa tay vẫy chào ống kính, sau đó thả tay xuống và bước đi tự nhiên trên máy. Mắt nhìn thẳng, di chuyển tại chỗ.

items.name: Di chuyển 2
items.prompt: Giữ khuôn mặt gốc, không thay đổi. Cô gái đặt tay phải chống lên eo, sải bước tự nhiên trên máy đi bộ. Phong thái tự tin, vui vẻ, mắt nhìn thẳng camera, di chuyển tại chỗ.

items.name: Di chuyển 3
items.prompt: Giữ khuôn mặt gốc, không thay đổi. Cô gái chống tay phải vào eo, bước đi đều đặn trên máy. Mắt nhìn thẳng sâu vào ống kính, biểu cảm lạnh lùng/cuốn hút, hạn chế tối đa nháy mắt, di chuyển tại chỗ.

items.name: Di chuyển 4
items.prompt: Giữ khuôn mặt gốc, không thay đổi. cô gái khẽ đưa tay vuốt lọn tóc rủ xuống mang tai, mỉm cười nhẹ nhàng, di chuyển tại chỗ.

items.name: Di chuyển 5
items.prompt: Giữ khuôn mặt gốc, không thay đổi. Cô gái bước đi nhịp nhàng trên máy, bất ngờ nháy mắt tinh nghịch với ống kính (tương tác với người xem), tay đung đưa tự nhiên theo nhịp chân.

items.name: Di chuyển 6
items.prompt: Giữ khuôn mặt gốc, không thay đổi. Đang đi bộ, cô gái khẽ nghiêng đầu sang một góc 45 độ rồi từ từ quay lại nhìn thẳng ống kính. Biểu cảm kiêu kỳ, bước đi nhịp nhàng, cố định tại một chỗ.

items.prompt: nhân vật mỉm cười tươi và đi lên 1 bước về phía trước, sau đó 2 bàn tay đặt sát nhau theo trục giữa cơ thể, lướt từ trên cổ áo xuống dưới theo đường mai của chiếc áo ở giữa đồng thời người phụ nữ cúi nhìn bộ trang phục để tạo thêm sự tự nhiên. Sau đó thì nhân vật xoay người sang bên trái đồng thời dùng tay kéo nhẹ chiếc áo để thể hiện sự co giãn của chiếc áo.

items.name: Áo dài · dáng 04

items.name: Áo dài · dáng 11
items.prompt: Người phụ nữ đứng thẳng, tay phải đặt lên thân áo, tay trái kéo nhẹ phần tay áo để thể hiện độ mềm và co giãn. Sau đó xoay người chậm rãi, giữ nét mặt tự nhiên, thanh lịch.

items.name: Yoga · co giãn linh hoạt
items.prompt: Đồ tập yoga co giãn linh hoạt – Người phụ nữ mỉm cười nhẹ, bước lên một bước nhỏ, hai tay đặt sát nhau vuốt từ cổ áo xuống thân áo theo trục giữa, ánh mắt cúi nhìn trang phục, sau đó xoay sang trái và kéo nhẹ áo để thể hiện độ co giãn và ôm dáng khi vận động.

items.name: Yoga · ôm dáng thoải mái
items.prompt: Đồ tập yoga ôm dáng thoải mái – Nhân vật nữ bước chậm về phía trước, hai tay khép trước thân lướt dọc áo từ cổ xuống eo giới thiệu form ôm, sau đó xoay sang trái kéo nhẹ áo chứng minh độ đàn hồi cao.

items.name: Yoga · thoáng khí dễ chịu
items.prompt: Đồ tập yoga thoáng khí dễ chịu – Người phụ nữ bước tự nhiên, hai tay vuốt từ cổ áo xuống thân áo tạo cảm giác gọn gàng, sau đó xoay sang trái kéo nhẹ áo thể hiện sự thoáng mát và dễ chịu khi tập luyện.

items.name: Yoga · vận động nhẹ nhàng
items.prompt: Đồ tập yoga vận động nhẹ nhàng – Nhân vật nữ bước một bước nhỏ, giữ thân thẳng, hai tay vuốt dọc thân áo từ cổ xuống eo, sau đó xoay sang trái kéo nhẹ áo thể hiện sự linh hoạt trong từng chuyển động.

items.name: Yoga · cho người mới tập

items.prompt: Đồ tập yoga mặc cả ngày – Người phụ nữ bước nhẹ, hai tay vuốt từ cổ áo xuống thân áo với biểu cảm thư giãn, sau đó xoay sang trái kéo nhẹ áo thể hiện sự thoải mái ngay cả khi sinh hoạt thường ngày.
